title: The future
summary: Talk about what will happen with `-(y)AcAk` (*geleceğim*, *okuyacak*), ask and refuse with *gelecek misin?* and *gelmeyeceğim*, handle *diyecek, yiyecek, gidecek, edecek*, and choose between the future and the present continuous for plans.
canDo: Say what you will do tomorrow, next week and next year
Ask someone about their plans, and say what you won't do
Make a prediction about the weather
Plan a trip: tickets, bookings and places to see
